hunks.sol: “You said it’s in a month. I’m going to get ready to leave.”

hunks.baseline: The time had come to leave Hubei behind.
hunks.sol: It was time to leave Hubei behind.

hunks.baseline: Together with those who were by my side—and whom I wanted by my side in the future.
hunks.sol: With the people who were by my side, and whom I wanted beside me in the days to come.

hunks.baseline: “I think I’ve given it enough time by now… don’t you?”
hunks.sol: “I think I’ve given you enough time by now… Don’t you?”

hunks.baseline: The mutter that slipped between my lips vanished without a trace beneath the noise around us.
hunks.sol: My mutter disappeared beneath the surrounding noise.

hunks.baseline: I scratched my chin as I looked up at the cliff rising into the distant sky.
hunks.sol: I scratched my chin and looked up at the dizzyingly high cliff.
